how.title: Yadda ake canzawa
how.step1.title: Zaɓi fayil ɗinka
how.step1.text: Danna Zaɓi fayiloli ko ja fayiloli zuwa cikin akwatin da ke sama. Fayil ɗaya ko da yawa a lokaci ɗaya.
how.step2.title: Zaɓi tsari
how.step2.text: Zaɓi tsarin da kake so ga kowane fayil, sannan ka danna Canza.
how.step3.title: Adana sakamakon
how.step3.text: Idan an gama, danna Zazzage don adana fayil ɗin a na'urarka.
formats.title: Tsare-tsaren da ake tallafawa
formats.lead: Ɗaruruwan haɗe-haɗen canji don nau'ikan fayiloli da aka fi amfani da su:
faq.title: Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi
faq.q1: Shin I Need Convert kyauta ne?
faq.a1: Eh, kyauta ne gaba ɗaya. Babu buƙatar yin rajista, shiga ko manhaja.
faq.q2: Shin ana loda fayiloli na zuwa sabar?
faq.a2: A'a. Kowane canji yana gudana kai tsaye a cikin burauzarka, don haka fayilolinka ba sa taɓa barin na'urarka. Shi ya sa yake da sauri kuma na sirri.
faq.q3: Waɗanne tsare-tsare ne za a iya canzawa?
faq.a3: Hotuna (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, GIF, BMP, ICO, SVG, TIFF, AVIF), bidiyo (MP4, WEBM, MOV, MKV, AVI, da sauransu), sauti (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC, AAC, OPUS), takardu (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, HTML), maƙunsar bayanai (XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, TSV), bayanai (JSON, YAML, XML) da ma'ajiyoyin ZIP. Kowane fayil kuma ana iya matse shi zuwa ZIP ko a mai da shi Base64.
faq.q4: Me yasa canza bidiyo ke ɗaukar ɗan lokaci?
faq.a4: Injin canji a cikin burauzarka ne ke sarrafa bidiyo, don haka saurin ya dogara da na'urarka. Idan akwati kawai ya canza (misali MP4 zuwa MKV), muna kwafar rafin bidiyo ba tare da sake shigar da lamba ba, don haka kusan nan take ne.
faq.q5: Ta yaya zan mai da PDF zuwa hotuna?
faq.a5: Zaɓi fayil na PDF, sannan zaɓi PNG ko JPG. Kowane shafi zai zama hoto ɗaya, kuma za ka iya zazzage su duka a lokaci ɗaya a matsayin ZIP.
faq.a6: Ba daga gare mu ba. Iyaka ɗaya kawai ita ce ƙwaƙwalwar na'urarka. Don bidiyo sama da 1–2 GB, kwamfuta ce ta fi dacewa.
